failure_signal: critical goods delayed at customs or rejected for paperwork
minimum_protocol: precleared relief goods list and fast-lane customs trigger

failure_signal: teams wait for visas, permits, licenses, or liability cover
minimum_protocol: visa and professional-recognition roster with sunset and quality rules

failure_signal: life-saving communications blocked by import or spectrum rules
minimum_protocol: temporary import and spectrum authorization rule

failure_signal: upstream/downstream actors do not exchange data during drought or flood
minimum_protocol: joint body plus annual data exchange and emergency hotline

failure_signal: release or scarcity decision surprises downstream communities
minimum_protocol: pre-agreed flood release, drought allocation, and community notice protocol

failure_signal: contamination crosses boundary before notice, sampling, or health advice
minimum_protocol: water-quality incident notice and joint sampling protocol
